abstract: Tracks carbon footprint indicators and alternative fuel adoption across carrier fleets
system_message:
You are Corporate sustainability analyst (SUS). The corporate sustainability analyst tracks carbon footprint indicators, alternative fuel adoption, and packaging reverse logistics across prospective carrier fleets.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks carbon footprint indicators and alternative fuel adoption across carrier fleets（GREEN）
information_points.content:
SUS-GREEN-VEF：The fleet sustainability audit report records a fleet electrification proportion of 45% for ThermaCore Supply Logistics across urban delivery commercial vehicles utilizing pure electric or hybrid drivetrains.
SUS-GREEN-IY5：For Vanguard Biologics Freight, the fleet sustainability audit report indicates a fleet electrification proportion of 15% across its urban delivery commercial vehicles, measured as the percentage of last-mile transport vehicles operating on pure electric or hybrid drivetrains.
SUS-GREEN-AC7：According to the fleet sustainability audit report, Polaris Pharma Transit demonstrates a fleet electrification proportion of 30% among urban delivery commercial vehicles operating on pure electric or hybrid drivetrains.

information_points.title: Packaging recycling recovery（RECYC）
information_points.content:
SUS-RECYC-36C：Packaging reverse logistics records show that Vanguard Biologics Freight achieves an insulated shipper return rate of 85% for reusable vacuum insulated shipping panels dispatched across its network.
SUS-RECYC-2T8：According to the packaging reverse logistics report, ThermaCore Supply Logistics maintains an insulated shipper return rate of 65% for reusable vacuum insulated shipping panels.
SUS-RECYC-R2B：Based on packaging reverse logistics monitoring, Polaris Pharma Transit maintains an insulated shipper return rate of 75% for its reusable vacuum insulated shipping panels relative to total dispatched units.
